record.title: DfCM frontier current
record.body: Frontier topology materially expanded by option-capital-recombination-pack. Before this run, fresh MEASURE exposed consumer replication as weakest multiplier with three immediate next EXPLORE demands: independently execute compiled target plans in ggen/cloud; add per-consumer receipts/falsifiers and dependency-relief conversion; enumerate additional exact repository targets. After R47: 25 reusable deterministic projection operators now connect Candidate x Capability x PublicOntology x MarketplacePack x Repository x Consumer x Verifier x Falsifier x RuntimeSurface; 10 gates fence authority/reversibility/falsifier/verifier/public-ontology/standing/leverage/composition constraints; 3 concrete reversible non-dominated candidates and 2 explicit compositions establish executable seed topology. Next non-dominated regions: higher-order N-way recombination, compatibility tensor, memory-driven candidate synthesis, cross-repo consumer adapter generation, verifier-fanout generation, calibrated multiplier benchmarks. Pairwise query connector refusal remains a failed edge, not graph failure. Observed 1000X is UNSUPPORTED; future leverage must be measured against independent consumers.
